discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological actions, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with large cardiovascular and renal outcome benefits. It has been recognized by the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough, Gairdner and other major prizes, and its clinical impact is now beyond doubt. The 2025 prize went to immunology (regulatory T cells), so a metabolic/endocrine topic is plausible. Habener, Mojsov and Drucker are the most frequently cited trio for identifying GLP-1 and establishing its incretin activity.
